Node.js process spawning native shell / interpreter — post-vm2-escape host execution AIExploitation Medium
Detects `node.exe` (or `node` on Linux) spawning a native shell or Windows LOLBin as a child process. After the CVE-2026-47140 escape, the attacker reaches `child_process.execFileSync(...)` in the host Node.js process — every successful exploitation surfaces here as an unexpected node→shell parent/child edge. Rationale: Article's PoC is `require("process").getBuiltinModule("child_process").execFileSync(...)` — every successful sandbox escape walks through node.exe → spawned-binary. Cross-checked with Hacker News and Semgrep coverage of the four sibling vm2 CVEs (47208/47137/47140/47131) confirming this parent/child edge is the common post-exploit primitive. The npm/yarn/pnpm filter strips the dominant FP class (lifecycle scripts). Cross-checked against: • https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/vm2-nodejs-library-vulnerabilities.html • https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/calling-back-to-vm2-and-escaping-sandbox/ • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rp36-8xq3-r6c4
ATT&CKT1059.007 T1059.003 T1059.001 T1190
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes
Expected false positives · estimated rate: medium — model-assessed, tune to your environment
  • npm/yarn/pnpm lifecycle scripts (postinstall, build) shelling out to native tooling (filter included)
  • Electron apps spawning helper binaries (e.g. updater) — typically signed parent, scope by AccountName !endswith $
  • Node-based build tools (esbuild, swc, sharp) calling native binaries during CI
  • DevOps tools like Pulumi/CDK invoking aws-cli or kubectl via Node
  • Serverless framework / SAM CLI invoking cloud-provider binaries
Suppression filter
| where not (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("npm-cli.js","yarn.js","pnpm.cjs","\\node_modules\\.bin\\")) and not (InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ ("npm.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd"))
Response runbook
Step 1 — Triage: Inspect ParentNodeCmd — does it run a web/API server (express, fastify, koa) accepting external input, or a CLI tool? If server, jump priority; check whether the JS being eval'd is attacker-controlled (look at upstream request logs around Timestamp ±60s). Cross-reference with UC1 hits to confirm vm2 is installed. Step 2 — Contain: Isolate the host via Defender Live Response; kill the node.exe PID; rotate any service credentials/tokens accessible to that process (env vars, .npmrc, cloud SDK creds). Step 3 — Hunt: Run UC3 against the same DeviceId for last 90 days to find prior PoC strings; check DeviceNetworkEvents for outbound from node.exe to non-corporate destinations; look for new ASEP entries written by that node.exe PID via DeviceRegistryEvents.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","hostname.exe","ipconfig.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentNodeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentNodeFolder = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          GrandparentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\node.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\cmd.exe", @"\powershell.exe", @"\pwsh.exe", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe", @"\mshta.exe", @"\rundll32.exe", @"\regsvr32.exe", @"\wmic.exe", @"\bitsadmin.exe", @"\certutil.exe", @"\curl.exe", @"\wget.exe", @"\bash.exe", @"\sh.exe", @"\whoami.exe", @"\net.exe", @"\hostname.exe", @"\ipconfig.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 8c41ba37-2e6a-49b4-9c1d-3a5f0d6b7e91
status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe spawning a Windows shell or LOLBin — the post-exploitation surface of vm2 NodeVM sandbox-escape CVEs (CVE-2026-47140 / 47208 / 47137 / 47131) where the attacker reaches host child_process.execFileSync().
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rp36-8xq3-r6c4
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/vm2-nodejs-library-vulnerabilities.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\hostname.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
  filter_npm_pm:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - '\npm-cli.js'
      - '\yarn.js'
      - '\pnpm.cjs'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_npm_pm
falsepositives:
  - npm/yarn/pnpm lifecycle scripts that wrap shell commands (filter included)
  - Node-based build tools running native binaries (esbuild, swc) during CI builds
  - Electron apps spawning helper binaries
level: high
source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) OR @ParentProcessName:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE)) (@Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\wget.exe OR *\whoami.exe OR *\hostname.exe OR *\ipconfig.exe OR *\net.exe) OR @NewProcessName:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\wget.exe OR *\whoami.exe OR *\hostname.exe OR *\ipconfig.exe OR *\net.exe)) NOT @ParentCommandLine:(*npm-cli.js* OR *yarn.js* OR *pnpm.cjs*)
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^node(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|wmic|bitsadmin|certutil|curl|wget|whoami|hostname|ipconfig|net|net1|bash|sh)\.exe$/i
| NOT (ParentCommandLine=/(npm-cli\.js|yarn\.js|pnpm\.cjs)/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentImageFileName], function=([count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, ParentCommandLine], multival=true)]))
| _count > 0
ENDPOINT
Toggle if your env has no CIM data-model acceleration.
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as child_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","whoami.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as child_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","whoami.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
vm2 NodeVM denylist bypass PoC strings — getBuiltinModule + inspector/promises AIExploitation High
Hunts for the literal sandbox-escape primitives from CVE-2026-47140: `getBuiltinModule("child_process")`, `require("inspector/promises")`, and `Runtime.evaluate` posted via an Inspector Session. These strings appearing in script content, written .js files, or process command lines is direct evidence of exploitation or PoC testing. Rationale: PoC strings from the advisory body are uniquely diagnostic — `getBuiltinModule("child_process")` and `require("inspector/promises")` are the literal escape primitives and have effectively zero benign use in production Node.js. Falcon's ScriptControlScanInfo (AMSI integration) carries the raw script body, making it the highest-fidelity surface; Defender/Sentinel fall back to process-cmdline + .js file writes outside node_modules. Cross-checked with Semgrep's coverage of the four sibling vm2 escapes confirming these are the new bypass tokens in the 3.11.4 patch. Cross-checked against: • https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/vm2-nodejs-library-vulnerabilities.html • https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/calling-back-to-vm2-and-escaping-sandbox/ • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rp36-8xq3-r6c4
ATT&CKT1059.007 T1480 T1211
Data sourcesEndpoint.Processes Endpoint.Filesystem
Expected false positives · estimated rate: low — model-assessed, tune to your environment
  • Security researchers / red team running the published GHSA PoC in a lab
  • vm2 maintainer regression tests after merging the 3.11.4 patch (look for repo path `vm2/poc/`)
  • Defender/EDR scanning a security advisory PDF or blog HTML and replaying the string
  • Internal CTF infrastructure where vm2 is the deliberate target
  • Snyk/Dependabot patch-validation runs that exercise the PoC
Suppression filter
| where not (FolderPath has_any (@"\node_modules\vm2\", @"\node_modules\vm2-", @"\poc\", @"\security-research\")) and not (InitiatingProcessAccountName has_any ("redteam","security-research","appsec-"))
Response runbook
Step 1 — Triage: Look at the surrounding script context — is the string in a server endpoint handler (e.g. `/eval`, `/run`, `/sandbox` route) or in a known PoC path (`/poc/`, `/test/`)? Confirm vm2 is loaded by the process (Defender `DeviceImageLoadEvents` for `vm2` folder under node_modules). Step 2 — Contain: If not a sanctioned researcher account, isolate host and kill the node.exe parent; rotate credentials/tokens the process had access to (env vars, AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, .npmrc). Capture the originating HTTP request (correlate with reverse-proxy logs ±10s) so the attacker payload is preserved. Step 3 — Hunt: Pivot on parent node.exe PID → DeviceProcessEvents for child binaries (UC2), DeviceNetworkEvents for unusual outbound, DeviceRegistryEvents for new ASEPs. Search the same tokens across the fleet for the last 90 days.
let bypass_tokens = dynamic(["getBuiltinModule","inspector/promises","Runtime.evaluate","require('process').getBuiltinModule","require(\"process\").getBuiltinModule"]);
let proc_hits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName =~ "node.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source="ProcessEvents", Image=FolderPath, Cmd=ProcessCommandLine, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let file_hits = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where FileName endswith ".js" or FileName endswith ".mjs" or FileName endswith ".cjs"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("npm.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.cmd","git.exe")
    | where FolderPath !contains @"\node_modules\"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Source="FileEvents", Image=FolderPath, Cmd=tostring(strcat(FolderPath,"\\",FileName)), ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
proc_hits
| union file_hits
| order by Timestamp desc
let bypass_tokens = dynamic(["getBuiltinModule","inspector/promises","Runtime.evaluate"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ActingProcessName endswith "node.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "node.exe" or TargetProcessName endswith "node.exe"
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens) or ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens) or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessCommandLine
| union (
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated" or EventType == "FileModified"
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".js" or TargetFileName endswith ".mjs" or TargetFileName endswith ".cjs"
    | where TargetFilePath !contains @"\node_modules\"
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (bypass_tokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName=ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessCommandLine="", TargetProcessCommandLine=TargetFilePath
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects the literal sandbox-escape primitives published in CVE-2026-47140 — `getBuiltinModule("child_process")`, `require("inspector/promises")`, and `Runtime.evaluate` posted via an Inspector Session — appearing in process command lines under node.exe.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rp36-8xq3-r6c4
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/vm2-nodejs-library-vulnerabilities.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering

tags:

logsource:
  category: process_creation

detection:
  selection_node:
    - Image|endswith: '\node.exe'
    - ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  selection_tokens:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'getBuiltinModule("child_process")'
      - "getBuiltinModule('child_process')"
      - 'require("inspector/promises")'
      - "require('inspector/promises')"
      - 'Runtime.evaluate'
  condition: selection_node and selection_tokens
falsepositives:
  - Security researchers running the published PoC in a lab
  - vm2 maintainer regression-test execution
  - Defender / EDR product telemetry replaying the PoC string in a scan event
level: critical
source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@Image:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) OR @ParentImage:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) OR @NewProcessName:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE) OR @ParentProcessName:(*\node.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE)) (@CommandLine:(*getBuiltinModule* OR *inspector\/promises* OR *Runtime.evaluate*) OR @ParentCommandLine:(*getBuiltinModule* OR *inspector\/promises* OR *Runtime.evaluate*))
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 OR #event_simpleName=SyntheticProcessRollup2 OR #event_simpleName=ScriptControlScanInfo)
| case {
    #event_simpleName=ScriptControlScanInfo | regex("(getBuiltinModule|inspector\/promises|Runtime\.evaluate)", field=ScriptContent);
    * | (ImageFileName=/\\node\.exe$/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/^node(\.exe)?$/i) | regex("(getBuiltinModule|inspector\/promises|Runtime\.evaluate)", field=CommandLine);
}
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, #event_simpleName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, ScriptContent], multival=true)]))

Asset exposure — vulnerability matches article CVE(s) Reconnaissance High
Match vulnerability scanner output to the CVE(s) named in the article.
ATT&CKT1190
Data sourcesVulnerabilities DeviceInfo DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
// TVM tables are daily snapshots — pin a 1-day window so the engine
// partitions on Timestamp instead of scanning the full retention.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-47140")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc

// Sentinel has no native TVM table. If MDE→Sentinel streaming is enabled,
// `DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities` is available. Otherwise this UC has
// no Sentinel translation — track via Update / Heartbeat OS-version
// gaps as a coarse approximation.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where CveId in~ ("CVE-2026-47140")
| join kind=inner (DeviceInfo | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, CveId,
          VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel asc, DeviceName asc
